name: Dimand S.A.
summary: Dimand S.A. is a Greek real estate firm primarily focused on acquiring, developing, and divesting property assets within Greece. Their diverse portfolio encompasses the creation of commercial spaces like offices and retail outlets, various residential solutions including apartments, hotels, and holiday resorts, along with industrial logistics hubs, athletic venues, and comprehensive urban revitalization initiatives. Furthermore, Dimand S.A. extends its expertise through a range of specialized services, including overseeing project execution and construction, managing retail network growth, offering technical guidance, and handling property maintenance. Established in 2002, the company maintains its headquarters in Maroussi, Greece.
